btrfs allows subvolumes and snapshots anywhere in the directory tree.
If we snapshot a subvolume that contains a link to other subvolume

column2: subvolA can be accessed through both the original

column1: subvolume and the snapshot. This is similar to creating hard link to

column2: and has the very similar problems.

column1: The aim of this patch is enforcing there is only one access point to
each subvolume. Only the first directory entry (the one added when
the subvolume/snapshot was created) is treated as valid access point.
The first directory entry is distinguished by checking root forward
reference. If the corresponding root forward reference is missing
we know the entry is not the first one.
This patch also adds snapshot/subvolume rename support
allows rename subvolume link across subvolumes.
